name: family-beacon-backend-tooling
description: Backend tooling and security-rules tests for Family Beacon. The mobile application is a Flutter project at the repository root; this manifest exists only so the Firebase command line tool and the rules test harness are pinned to a version rather than depending on what happens to be installed on a machine.

scripts.test:callables: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,functions --project family-beacon-test "node --test 'test/functions/**/*.test.mjs'"
